name: Unit Converter
description: Convert a quantity between metric and imperial units of length, mass and temperature. Pure arithmetic: it makes no network requests, reads no files and stores nothing.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert a numeric value from one unit to another within the same dimension, for example 12 inches to centimetres. Returns the converted value as a number. Performs no requests.

tools.name: list_units
tools.description: Return the units this skill understands, grouped by dimension. Takes no arguments and performs no requests.
